maya: Heads-up — JunoRides (partner) flagged an issue on invoice `INV-2026-119`. Looks like a vendor rebate and a promo credit were both applied, and the promo credit appears to have been applied twice to end customers. Customer-facing team says they're seeing unexpected refunds. Need reconciliation and a proposal for a manual adjustment.
sam: Pulling the invoice now — link: https://billing.redwood.com/invoices/INV-2026-119
maya: Quick ledger snippet I pulled: `2026-03-01 REV: -12,400 (vendor_rebate); 2026-03-01 CR: -6,200 (promo_credit); 2026-03-01 CR: -6,200 (promo_credit)` — the two `promo_credit` lines look duplicated.
finance-bot: Automated: created refund workflow R-8801 for invoice INV-2026-119 (status: pending).
leo: If promo credit was duplicated we should reverse one credit and issue a goodwill credit to the affected customers if necessary. Need approval to post a manual billing adjustment to restore $6,200 to the revenue ledger and notify partner ops. cc @olivia
olivia: I approve a manual adjustment to remove the duplicated promo credit from our books and to issue a $6,200 goodwill credit where customers were double-refunded. Please include the note: "promo double-apply — customer goodwill; no SLA impact" and route through billing ops.
sam: On it — I'll create journal entry `JD-2201` and update invoice with a correction line. I'll also schedule the settlement hold for partner payout until we confirm vendor rebate state. Running reconciliation now.
maya: Thanks — leo, can you confirm with partner success whether the vendor rebate has already been paid out? If vendor already received funds we'll net on next settlement; otherwise we can correct now.
leo: I'll ping partner success and add internal ticket `BILL-4729` for tracking. If partner paid, we'll offset next settlement and document the change. If not, we'll void the extra rebate and update the invoice immediately.
maya: Sounds good. Marking this thread resolved for finance until partner confirms. Will update when settlement path is decided. :white_check_mark:
